goal: I am a software developer. I need to modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules. Before changing the code, I need to understand the main components involved in this functionality, their responsibilities, and how they interact with each other. I also want to identify which parts of the system may be affected by the modification.

elements.name: ReservationController
responsibilities: REST entry point for creating, cancelling and checking in reservations

elements.name: LibraryFacade
responsibilities: single facade delegating requests to the managers

elements.name: ReservationManager
responsibilities: validates and creates reservations, assigns seats, cancels and checks in

fragments.guard: student is null -> IllegalArgumentException("Student not found.")
room missing, inactive or closed on date -> IllegalArgumentException
area null or not in selected room -> IllegalArgumentException("The area is not in the selected room")
date in the past, or slot not found/already started -> IllegalArgumentException("The selected time slot is not available")
seatId != 0 and seat not found or not in area -> IllegalArgumentException
duplicate reservation -> IllegalArgumentException("You already have an active or confirmed reservation...")
no available seats -> IllegalArgumentException("No seats are available in the selected area")
seatId > 0 and seat taken -> IllegalStateException("The selected seat is no longer available")
save returns false -> RuntimeException("Server error: the reservation could not be saved...")

limitations: one scenario per view; also recovered: make reservation
